Hyperpigmentation has oc- curred in patients given daunorubicin, doxorubicin, or idaru- bicin.1-6 Reports described pigmentation of the skin and trans- verse hyperpigmented bands of the nails. Effects on the skin resolved over several weeks, and bands on the nails moved with normal nail growth. Dark-skinned patients appear to be more susceptible to this adverse effect.
